label: Profile
headline: expose.u is a Berlin-based documentation studio run by people who work inside the cultural scene — not just around it.
subline: Fast delivery. No generic coverage. Documented with the same care the artists put into making it.

sections.label: The Work
sections.body: Photo and video for concerts, exhibitions, and events. Delivered for press, social, and archive.

sections.label: The Standard
sections.body: Nothing generic. Every project gets a visual approach built for its specific context — the space, the artists, the room.

sections.label: Where we've worked
sections.body: Eight concert nights at Silent Green Kulturquartier. Gallery openings, artist sessions, and brand events across Berlin.

sections.label: How we work
sections.body: Tell us about the event. We show up, cover it, and deliver press-ready files within 24–48 hours.

sections.label: Who hires us
sections.body: Venues and promoters. Galleries and cultural institutions. Artists and musicians. Agencies and brands. Berlin-based — available across Europe.

sections.label: Start here
sections.body: Something coming up? Tell us about it.
